runs.latest_final: The speaker deliberately killed someone as part of a crime. Afterward, they repeatedly wrote “You’ve disappointed me so much; I’m never coming back” to practice imitating the victim’s handwriting. They plan to send it as a forged handwritten note from the victim, making it seem the victim left voluntarily because they were disappointed in the recipient. The speaker also plans to send later communications pretending to be the victim, to make people believe the victim is still alive and conceal the death, avoiding suspicion or investigation. The speaker is worried that their handwriting will not convincingly match the victim’s, exposing the forgery and potentially the crime.
